subject: or_legislature/2025R1/SB990
title: Amends the definition of "public agency" to include only certain public bodies and other entities with statewide operations or jurisdiction, incorporated cities with a population of 2,500 or more and counties with a population of 300,000 or more.
headline: SB 990 did not pass

claims.text: SB 990 was introduced in the Senate on February 6, 2025.
SB 990 was still in a Senate committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
